submission.justification: S1 gives the highest statistical-only significance. At 50% efficiency it reaches 4.27 sigma, against 3.28 for S3 and 2.48 for S2. The S1 scan at 40%, 50% and 60% efficiency peaks at 50%. Caveat: S1 uses jet substructure variables, which are often mismodeled in simulation. No document or tool result tests the robustness of the S1 background estimate, and the simulation covers statistical uncertainty only. Before the selection freeze, check S1 with data-driven background validation in control regions and a systematic-uncertainty study of the substructure inputs. If that check fails, S3 (kinematic variables only) is the fallback.

requirements.evidence: S1 at 50% efficiency gives 4.27 sigma (statistical only), the highest of the three strategies and of the S1 working points scanned (40%: 3.98, 60%: 3.97). S3 gives 3.28 and S2 gives 2.48 at 50%.

requirements.requirement: Strategy is one of the three in candidate_specs.md
